title: Data and analysis code for "Delineating the applicability domain of an AI affinity predictor using an experimentally standardized membrane-protein benchmark"
description: Target-level aggregate data and analysis code supporting the manuscript "Delineating the applicability domain of an AI affinity predictor using an experimentally standardized membrane-protein benchmark". The archive contains per-target screening outcomes, structural classifications and structure-derived descriptors for 295 G protein-coupled receptors and 296 solute carrier transporters; consolidated virtual-screening metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals for the 43 targets with complete compound-level binding data; public-data proxies for representation in the model's training domain; measures of the consistency of model-generated ligand placements; held-out evaluations of the separation index; and the scripts that regenerate every reported statistic from these files. Per-compound data are not included and are not required to reproduce any reported statistical analysis, figure or table. Code is released under the MIT License; data are released under CC BY 4.0.
